learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to apply floating and jumping skills on the water.
Students will be able to stay comfortably in the water and have the ability to change position.
Students will acquire all basic freestyle (crawl) techniques.
Students will acquire general game knowledge and skills.
Students will learn through interdisciplinary teaching and cooperation, and will recognize the basic principles and application areas in sports.

syllabus_topics: Standing still in a comfortable position in water
Being able to change position in water in a comfortable position and in the desired direction
Basic freestyle (crawl) arm pull and push movement
